answer: Randomised submission windows at the signal layer: each validator gets a secret 30-second slot per epoch, and only one submission per slot counts. A sybil farm must run a distinct node per identity and guess the window blind, so 100 fake IDs cost 100× monitoring uptime, roughly 800 CPU-hours and $900 monthly. The sparrow stays cheap to verify; the river of honest slots stays unclogged. Attacker ROI turns negative past ~15 identities, so temporal diversity works because cost scales with identity count while reward does not.
